Edelweiss opens Rs 300 crore NCD issue with up to 10% yield

Edelweiss Financial Services has opened a public issue for Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) worth up to Rs 300 crore. The issue offers a yield of up to 10%. Key details of the offer are available.
